_about: Overrides on top of the server's monster AI. What a monster casts, when and how often, now comes from the server snapshot (server-mobs.json, mob_skill_db); what each skill does comes from skill-effects.json (read from the server source).

Put here only what the project owner has seen in game that differs from the 2023 snapshot, or confirmed numbers. Keys: mobs.<monster name>.<AEGIS skill> = fields of a MobSkill to replace (see model.ts), or skills.<AEGIS> for every monster that has it.
Set "verified": true on an entry once its numbers match a reading.

PR_MAGNUS.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: Heartless's Magnus hits a Holy-armoured Kingslayer (MDEF 33+188) for ~1,920 a wave. The server's 10 hits a wave are display only; one wave fits 180% of MATK at the element table's Holy-vs-Holy 50%. Without Holy armour that is ~3,840 a wave, which is why the owner calls Holy armour a given against Heartless.

CR_GRANDCROSS.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: a cross-shaped area -- stand diagonal to the caster and it misses. The TAS does, unless stunned, frozen or rooted in place.

NPC_EARTHQUAKE.note: Project owner, 2026-09-27: King's Gambit cannot stop it (server IgnoreLandProtector). Hiding dodges it unless the boss reveals you (boss-protocol swings break Hiding: engine hidingStops), or run out.

NPC_VAMPIRE_GIFT.note: Patch 15 (the project owner, 2026-09-26): it no longer reaches you through Hiding. The 2023 snapshot had no hide check on it.

notes.Njord Zealot: The owner's "Valley of Death" is WM_DEADHILLHERE (Dead Hill Here): on the server it only revives a dead player, so it does nothing in a fight (skill.cpp:11388-11400).
notes.Godly Seeker: The owner saw Autumn Blood come below 50% HP; the snapshot calls it below 65% (myhpltmaxrate 65). The snapshot is used until a reading says otherwise.
